# Anklesh Rawat

> Investment research, strategy, and financial analysis. MBA, IIM Bodh Gaya.
> Work spans credit, equities, macro, market structure, climate macro,
> sustainable finance, and product strategy. Each analysis is published as
> something openly inspectable: a live dashboard, a working paper, or a case
> study. Contact: anklesh.r@merinth.in

Site: https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app

Everything below is also browsable as one filterable index at
https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/work, narrowable by subject
(?domain=credit, equities, macro, product, quant, sustainable, climate,
market-structure, policy). The index is grouped and ordered: selected work,
working papers, dashboards, then reports and decks.

## Publications

- [Regulating the Retail Options Boom](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/regulating-retail-options-boom):
  SSRN working paper (July 2026), with Shreshtha Rawat. Difference-in-differences
  evaluation of SEBI's 2024-25 equity index derivatives reforms using untargeted
  stock options as a within-market control over a 48-month NSE and BSE panel.
  Index-options notional turnover fell 37-43% below counterfactual, premium
  turnover fell only ~13%, unique individual traders fell 20% with the steepest
  declines in the smallest turnover cohorts, and no substitution into the cash
  market was detected. JEL G14, G18, G28, G12, G41.
  SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=7135161

- [Awareness Without Uptake](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/awareness-without-uptake):
  SSRN working paper (August 2026). Administrative burden and delivery
  architecture across four co-located social protection schemes in rural Bihar,
  measured in the same 51 households in one round so poverty, literacy and
  distance are held constant by construction. Awareness was high and flat
  (64.7% PDS to 100% JEEViKA); entitlement conversion varied far more. The three
  schemes obtainable inside the village converted at 0.79 to 0.98, AB-PM-JAY,
  which requires documented enrolment outside it, at 0.42 despite being better
  known than PDS. Among households receiving nothing, procedural complexity
  (69.2%) and administrative distance (57.7%) outranked lack of information
  (30.8%). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/abstract=7239538

## Projects

- [Ground Truth](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/datacentre-capacity-audit):
  Forensic read of India's data centre buildout, announced against delivered.
  10.6 GW announced across 8 operators against 619 MW live, which is 5.8% of the
  announcement and a factor of 17 between the two numbers. Only 2 of 8 operators
  are traced to a primary filing; the rest carry a secondary or unverified tag on
  every row. One prospectus defines built capacity as the maximum IT load a
  facility is engineered to support, so nothing has to be constructed for the
  number to be true. Anant Raj announces 307 MW, calls 28 MW operational and
  reports 8 MW handed to customers. Reading all 433 pages of Techno Electric's
  annual report yields 896.35 mn of overdue receivables the auditor flagged and
  194.59 mn moved from payables into borrowings with no cash moving, against no
  segment disclosure at all. 104 published claims are pinned as build invariants,
  so a claim that stops being true fails the build.
  Live: https://datacenter-capacity-audit.vercel.app/
  Code: https://github.com/DogInfantry/datacentre-announced-vs-delivered

- [India's Wide-Body Window](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/india-widebody-window):
  Commercial aviation market-entry case. Where 60 A350-900s on firm order and 40
  unconverted purchase rights should be deployed through 2030. The answer is to
  compete with the Gulf hubs rather than fly more aircraft to them: the Gulf
  carries 50.9% of India's international traffic yet is the only corridor with
  negative yield headroom (-4.3% against Europe +21.3% and North America
  +31.5%), 8.5M of its passengers a year are only connecting through it, and
  remaining treaty room would absorb about 4% of the order book. Computed from
  DGCA, Eurostat, IATA and World Bank data; the opposite recommendation was
  overturned mid-case and documented in a pivot log.
- [India FS Pulse](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/india-fs-pulse):
  Who captures the value in India's UPI when the busiest half of the network is
  priced at zero. In 2026 Q2 merchant payments were 63.9% of transactions but
  23.0% of value and earned Rs 0 under zero-MDR, where 30bps would have been
  Rs 3,144 crore a quarter. PhonePe (45.9%) and Google Pay (32.3%) both sit above
  the 30% NPCI cap. Private against public bank margin gap of 114 bps. Seven
  public sources, refreshed monthly by CI, every figure traced to a committed
  dataset.
- [Sellside Research Engine](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/sellside-research-engine):
  Equity research terminal with DCF and reverse-DCF valuation, a five-pillar
  composite rating, eight risk metrics, and NLP scoring of management commentary.
- [Capital Markets Intelligence Platform](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/capital-markets-intelligence):
  Six open-data models: cross-asset regime scoring, yield-curve decomposition,
  IPO event studies across 25 offerings, M&A pipeline screening, sovereign risk.
- [ENSO Macro Risk Desk](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/enso-macro-risk-desk):
  Commodity risk desk built on the El Nino-Southern Oscillation, with Granger and
  CCM causal testing of every headline ENSO-to-commodity trade.
- [Dynamic Debt Covenant Surveillance Engine](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/debt-covenant-surveillance):
  AST-safe covenant monitoring over live SEC filings across $263B of issuer debt,
  with cross-default cascade simulation and macro shock sensitivity.
- [India Sustainable Finance Transition Dashboard](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/sustainable-finance-india):
  Green bond issuance, SEBI and RBI frameworks, and transition finance for
  India's hard-to-abate sectors.
- [Signals Before Storms](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/signals-before-storms):
  HMM regime overlay for tactical asset allocation, graded on 1,814 out-of-sample
  days across India and the US. Published as a negative result with a diagnosis:
  the states order volatility and not return, so no book separates from 60/40 or
  equal weight on Sharpe, though max drawdown falls to -6.2% from -23.7%.
- [IndusInd Protect: Bancassurance Product Case Study](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/projects/indusind-protect):
  Product case study for an in-app insurance layer: 60-respondent survey and
  interviews, a benchmark of five competitors (PolicyBazaar, Acko, Digit, ICICI
  Lombard, SBI General), three personas, RICE-scored feature ranking, wireframes
  and prototype, and a 42-month go-to-market plan.

## Research reports

- [India's Critical Minerals & Green Steel Transition](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/india-strategic-metals-transition):
  Strategic roadmap for the energy-transition value chain and mid-market steel.
- [Bridging India's MSME Credit Gap](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/msme-credit):
  Account Aggregator rails and a DPI-native RegTech execution layer.
- [The ESG Advantage](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/esg-value-and-resilience):
  ESG value case on RPG Life Sciences, quantifying carbon-tax exposure.
- [River-as-a-Service](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/river-as-a-service):
  Shifting river management from a hardware-centric vendor model to a
  software-driven ecosystem.
- [EUR/USD: Reading the Majors](https://portfolio-five-rouge-90.vercel.app/research/eurusd-currency-analysis):
  Currency movements, trading patterns, and signals in the euro/dollar pair.
